jobs.instruction: Implement a pure Python function compare_g3_captioned_png_asset_coverage(expected_figures_by_slide, exported_figures_by_slide). Each input is a list of slides, each slide a list of caption identifiers. Return a dictionary with technical_asset_coverage_match, mismatched_slides as one-based slide numbers, independent_scientific_acceptance=False, independent_visual_semantic_acceptance=False, student_publication_authorized=False. Reject blanks, nonstrings, duplicates, missing slides and extra asset identifiers. Technical metadata matching alone never verifies the science or visual meaning.

Implement pure Python function compare_g3_narration_segment_page_index(expected_page_ids, observed_page_ids) to compare ordered positive integer page IDs including length, duplicates, missing and reordered positions. Return technical_page_index_match, mismatched_positions as one-based positions, independent_scientific_acceptance=False, independent_acoustic_acceptance=False, student_publication_authorized=False. Boolean, negative, zero and string page indices are never valid. A technical page-index match is not independent review of speech, timing, physics or visuals.
